name: New Mexico

voter_file.who_may_get: Any requester who makes a written request and signs an affidavit (NMSA 1-4-5.5(A), (C)).
voter_file.permitted_uses: Governmental or election and election campaign purposes only (1-4-5.5(C), (E)).
voter_file.use_restriction: NMSA 1-4-5.5(C): 'Each requester of voter data, mailing labels or special voter lists shall sign an affidavit that the voter data, mailing labels and special voter lists shall be used for governmental or election and election campaign purposes only and shall not be made available or used for unlawful purposes.' 1-4-5.5(E): '(1) "election campaign purposes" means relating in any way to a campaign in an election conducted by a federal, state or local government; (2) "governmental purposes" means noncommercial purposes relating in any way to the structure, operation or decision-making of a federal, state or local government'.
voter_file.penalty: Fourth degree felony plus $100 per line of voter information, including making voter data that identifies a voter publicly available on the internet (NMSA 1-4-5.6).
voter_file.attestation_required: Affidavit (Secretary of State form) that the data will be used for governmental or election and election campaign purposes only (1-4-5.5(C)-(D)).

private_challenge.who: No private challenge was found. At the polls, only an election board member or a party challenger may challenge (NMSA 1-12-20). Before an election, only the Secretary of State may petition the district court to cancel registrations (NMSA 1-4-22).

state_windows.applies_to: Secretary of State petitions to the district court to cancel registrations (NMSA 1-4-22)
state_windows.effect: A petition may be filed only at a time not less than 120 days before a statewide election (and after it).

county_board.name: New Mexico county clerk information (Secretary of State)

state_election_office.name: New Mexico Secretary of State - Voting and Elections
state_election_office.note: Only the Secretary of State may petition the court to cancel registrations (NMSA 1-4-22).

ag.name: New Mexico Department of Justice (Attorney General)

gates.basis: Jury records: status unknown (null), so counts only. No private challenge exists; only the Secretary of State may petition to cancel, and not within 120 days of a statewide election. Strict gates.

notes: Extra blackout: state_extra_days is 30 because NMSA 1-4-22 bars the Secretary of State's cancellation petitions within 120 days before a statewide election (120 - 90 = 30).

Use limit: voter data may be used only for governmental or election campaign purposes, under affidavit (1-4-5.5). The Justia annotation reports a federal ruling that limited enforcement of New Mexico's online-publication restrictions against one organization; the ruling is not relied on, and JuryRoll never publishes data.
Source note: NMSA was read from the Justia copy of the 2025 statutes (the official NMOneSource site is a script-only application).
Voter data excludes day and month of birth (1-4-5.5(B)), so dob_in_public_file is false.
